Vendored browser libraries for the "Download PDF" button.
Served from this app, never from a CDN, so the factory keeps working on a flaky line.

  jspdf         4.2.1   (MIT)
  html2canvas   1.4.1   (MIT)

To refresh: npm install jspdf html2canvas, then copy
  node_modules/jspdf/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js
  node_modules/html2canvas/dist/html2canvas.min.js
